summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of TRY Cash luxury wallet app. Executed full login flow (admin fingerprint modal → security-question fallback) and verified every requirement in the review request: home header (username on RIGHT + bell/theme on LEFT in RTL), 3-currency mini-cards grid with gold-active state, active-balance detail card with Exchange pill + Receive/Send buttons, Recent Transactions empty state + see-all link, bottom nav (RTL order with home rightmost, 3 dividers via ::after pseudo-element, scanner FAB restricted to /app/home only), classic white QR with black print + gold TC logo overlay, Scanner page shows only Enable-Camera (upload button removed), notification bell with persistent 'verify account' notif for unverified users. 33 of 34 assertions passed (~97%). One HIGH-priority routing bug found: btn-exchange → /app/exchange has no matching Route (blank page).

integration_issues.issue: Clicking [data-testid=btn-exchange] navigates to /app/exchange, but this Route is NOT registered in /app/frontend/src/App.js. React Router logs 'No routes matched location "/app/exchange"' and the user sees a blank page (only the AppLayout shell + 'Made with Emergent' badge render). All other buttons (btn-receive → /app/receive, btn-send → /app/send) resolve correctly.

action_items: Register an /app/exchange route in /app/frontend/src/App.js (add a new AppExchange page component or point btn-exchange to an existing route). Currently the Exchange pill on the home hero card is a dead link.
critical_code_review_comments: AppHome.jsx line 30: `useState('SYP')` — initial selected currency is hardcoded to SYP. Consider deriving from user's preference or highest-balance wallet.

AppHome.jsx line 35: `WALLETS.find(...)` assumes the key always matches; if `selected` ever becomes stale (e.g., user removes a wallet in future), `activeWallet` could be undefined and crash at line 114 (`wname(activeWallet)`) and 119 (`activeWallet.symbol`). Add a fallback.

AppLayout.jsx line 26: `[...baseTabs].reverse()` mutates a shallow copy which is fine, but note that the `dir="ltr"` on the nav element (line 56) combined with the manual reverse is confusing. A single approach (either CSS-based flex-direction:row-reverse for Arabic OR array reverse) would be cleaner and eliminate the mixed directional logic.

AppReceive.jsx line 23: External QR service (api.qrserver.com) is a third-party dependency; if it goes down, the QR won't render. Consider using a local QR-code library (e.g., qrcode.react) for offline resilience.

NotificationBell.jsx line 23-24: `useMemo` depends on `[current, open]` — recomputes on every open toggle. Fine for now, but `getNotifs` reads localStorage each time; consider a context or subscription pattern when notifications scale.
notifications.js line 20: `list.unshift(...)` mutates the array returned by `read()` — safe because read() returns a fresh parse, but flag for future refactoring if caching is added.
Missing /app/exchange route (already listed above under action_items — considered CRITICAL because the button is clearly labeled 'صرف العملات' but does nothing).
test_credentials: Admin: trycashsupport@gmail.com / asd.fhd.nemr — security answer: فاطمة بطيخ (read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Used existing pre-seeded admin. For persistent-verify-notif test, temporarily flipped `isVerified` to false in localStorage keys `trycash_current_user` and `trycash_users['trycashsupport@gmail.com']`, then restored to true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: localStorage keys are `trycash_current_user` (object) and `trycash_users` (object keyed by email, NOT an array). Do NOT use Array.isArray or findIndex on `trycash_users`. Admin is pre-verified so persistent-verify notif requires flipping isVerified=false in BOTH keys and reload. Nav dividers are implemented via `.trycash-nav-divider::after` pseudo-element (1px gold gradient) — checking `borderRightStyle` will falsely fail; use getComputedStyle(el, '::after'). The /app/exchange route is missing — verify main agent adds it before retest.

failed_assertions: btn-exchange navigation: URL becomes /app/exchange but no Route matches → blank page

rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1) Login as admin. 2) Navigate to /app/home. 3) Click the Exchange pill (data-testid=btn-exchange) on the balance hero card. 4) Observe blank content area with only the layout shell + bottom nav visible.
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In /app/frontend/src/App.js the <Route path="exchange" ...> is not registered under the /app parent route. The buttonhandler navigate('/app/exchange') in AppHome.jsx works, but React Router falls through with 'No routes matched location'.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Create /app/frontend/src/pages/app/AppExchange.jsx and add `<Route path="exchange" element={<AppExchange />} />` inside the /app parent route block in App.js. Alternatively, temporarily point btn-exchange to /app/services or wrap it in a coming-soon toast.
